FULL TEXT:
ASSISTANT CASHIER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No. 17/R&A Dated: 06th March, 2025
In continuation to this Court’s Notice No. 01/R&A, dated 03.01.2025, all concerned are hereby
informed that Computer Proficiency Test for appointment to the post of Assistant Cashier (under
Advertisement No. PHC/02/2024) in the establishment of this Court is scheduled to be held on 22.03.2025
(Saturday) in single shift in the premises of Patna High Court.
Marking scheme of the Computer Proficiency Test shall be as below:
Stage of
Examination Section Full Marks
Minimum
Qualifying
Marks (40%)
Duration
Computer
Proficiency Test
Word processing Test on MS Word 20 08
30 Minutes
Test in Spread Sheets on MS Excel 20 08
Internet Proficiency 10 04
Total 50 20
Admit cards of eligible candidates for appearing at the Computer Proficiency Test shall remain
available from 18.03.2025 onwards, on the official website of the High Court i.e.
www.patnahighcourt.gov.in. The candidates may download their admit cards from the Court’s website. The
candidates are directed to strictly follow the instructions mentioned in the Admit Card.
Admit Card would not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode. No TA/DA will
be paid for appearing at the Computer Proficiency Test. No request for change in the venue or the schedule
of Computer Proficiency Test shall be entertained. The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s
official website regularly for further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General
